exposure: unilateral early breast sucking within 2 hours of delivery
bilateral early breast sucking within 2 hours of delivery
outcome: nutritional status (Alb, PA, Hb, D-D levels)
finding: Bilateral early breast sucking within 2 h after delivery was associated with increased lactation, reduced breast distending pain and postpartum lochia, improved maternal nutritional status and coagulation function, reduced incidence of postpartum complications, and improved breastfeeding rate.
